reply_text:
I've sent Dana the list in her DM. I read all six of Moss's digests in the shared files, which are all public. Two of them have Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

- **#PD-4492** is in "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (2025-10-05). It was about the gatehouse kiosk at the Eau Claire yard not sending text-message bay assignments for Dock Doors 14–18. Support fixed it on 4 Oct, and Thea Ramaswell confirmed the fix on 5 Oct.
- **#4419** is in "Moss: North cheat sheet," which has no date. It was about barcode scanners at Door 14 not reading trailer tags. It was passed to tier-2 support for firmware testing.

I also told her what I left out and why:
- Moss's 9/14 pipeline digest and 3/23 renewal note mention QFL but don't give any ticket numbers.
- Tickets #4409 and #4412 in Moss's Central handoffs digest belong to a different account.
- Marcus's "Quarendon Freightways" note is about another company, which isn't a customer.

Because the cheat sheet has no date, I suggested Dana check #4419 before putting it in the weekly notes. Its number also doesn't have the PD- prefix, so the two tickets may come from different systems.

I didn't read any channels or use message search, so this list only covers Moss's files.
